Placemaker.Beach.Name: Beach
Placemaker.Recipe.Beach.Description: Sand carved into a gentle slope to the water, umbrellas and loungers, lifeguards, a back path with showers and changing huts, dunes behind.
Placemaker.Beach.style.Tooltip: Sandy, rocky/pebble, river, cove or volleyball beach. Each lays out the shore differently.
Placemaker.Beach.waterSide.Tooltip: Which side of the area faces the water. Automatic finds the water; otherwise pick a side (north = +Z on the map).
Placemaker.Beach.beachDepth.Tooltip: How far the sand reaches inland from the waterline to the back path.
Placemaker.Beach.umbrellas.Tooltip: Umbrella sets (an umbrella with loungers) per hectare of sand.
Placemaker.Beach.layout.Tooltip: Loose groups like a public beach, or tidy rows like a resort lido.
Placemaker.Beach.carve.Tooltip: Lower the ground into a gentle slope down to the waterline (permanent). Never raises it.
Placemaker.Beach.slope.Tooltip: Gradient of the carved beach. Real sand beaches are 2–8 %.
Placemaker.Beach.wetBand.Tooltip: Strip along the water kept free of umbrellas (boats, rocks and tide pools go here).
Placemaker.Beach.sandSurface.Tooltip: Cover the beach with a sand surface.
Placemaker.Beach.paint.Tooltip: Paint the terrain texture under the beach (permanent). Use a sand layer for sand, a gravel or rock layer for pebbles.
Placemaker.Beach.paintLayer.Tooltip: Which of the map's four extra terrain textures to paint (map dependent).
Placemaker.Beach.backdrop.Tooltip: What lies behind the back path: dunes with marram grass, a lawn, woods, or nothing.
Placemaker.Beach.duneDepth.Tooltip: How deep the dune belt (or the planted strip) is behind the back path.
Placemaker.Beach.duneFence.Tooltip: Short fence runs along the dune foot, with gaps where paths cross.
Placemaker.Beach.grassDensity.Tooltip: How much grass and scrub grows on the dunes or along the backdrop edge.
Placemaker.Beach.backPath.Tooltip: A path behind the sand, parallel to the water, with benches, lamps, huts and kiosks.
Placemaker.Beach.accessSpacing.Tooltip: Distance between the boardwalks that cross the sand to the water.
Placemaker.Beach.benchSpacing.Tooltip: Benches facing the sea along the back path. 0 = none.
Placemaker.Beach.showers.Tooltip: A shower at the end of each beach access.
Placemaker.Beach.huts.Tooltip: Small groups of changing huts, or a long row of beach huts behind the back path.
Placemaker.Beach.courts.Tooltip: Volleyball courts on the sand, parallel to the water. The volleyball beach adds some automatically.
Placemaker.Beach.boats.Tooltip: Rowing boats and kayaks pulled up on the wet sand.
Placemaker.Beach.fires.Tooltip: Fire pits with seats around them on the sand.
Placemaker.Beach.rockClusters.Tooltip: Groups of rocks; on a rocky beach they straddle the waterline, in a cove they also form headlands.
Placemaker.Beach.tidePools.Tooltip: Shallow hollows near the waterline ringed by rocks (permanent terrain change).
Placemaker.Beach.shopLayout.Tooltip: A continuous band along the street, or separate shop pads.
Placemaker.Beach.shopDepth.Tooltip: How deep the zoned band reaches into the area (whole 8 m cells).
Placemaker.Beach.Issue.NoCourtSpace: The beach is too shallow for volleyball courts.
Placemaker.Beach.Issue.FewerCourts: Only {0} of {1} volleyball courts fit on the sand.
Placemaker.Shore.Issue.NoWater: No water found next to the area: it faces away from the road (or the longest edge). Set Water side to choose.
Placemaker.Shore.Issue.WaterInside: Much of the area is water: only the dry part is built on.
Placemaker.AddOn.BeachBar.Name: Beach bar
Placemaker.AddOn.BeachBar.tables.Tooltip: Cafe tables on the terrace in front of each bar.
